mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.organization_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.sn_userid, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.theme, u.font, u.language, org.organization_id, org.py_name, org.py_label, org.website, org.tel, org.address, org.description, org.create_by, org.create_time, org.update_by, org.update_time, org.uuid, org.bank_name, org.bank_account, org.fapiao_delivery, org.avatar as org_avatar, org.larger_avatar, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_organization org on u.organization_id::text = org.organization_id::text left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_id, u.organization_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.avatar, u.create_time, u.theme, u.font, u.language from sys_user u left join sys_organization org on u.organization_id::text = org.organization_id::text left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
select user_id, user_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
